title: Report: Kyler Gordon away from the Bears as he works to recover from calf injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Kyler Gordon away from the Bears as he works to recover from calf injury
sources.description: Bears General Manager Ryan Poles said recently that he doesn't know if cornerback Kyler Gordon will play for the team again and Gordon reportedly isn't with the team as he tries to work his way back from a calf injury.
